info.title: Applystead API
info.description: Search Applystead's job data and add applications to your queue from your own code. Create keys on the API page in Applystead and send one as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Calls are paid from your prepaid balance; Premium members pay 40% less. Every response says what it charged (charged_usd) and what is left (balance_usd). Applications you add are refunded automatically if they are never sent. Webhooks tell your own HTTPS endpoint, or a Discord or Slack channel, as soon as one of your applications is sent: free with Premium, otherwise priced per delivery.

post.description: Free to add. Each delivery: Charged per delivery: $0.0010, free with Premium. An endpoint is an https URL on port 443 at a public host, up to 3 per account. A Discord or Slack incoming-webhook URL gets a short chat message naming the job instead of the JSON event (format discord or slack). The response carries the endpoint's signing secret once: keep it to check each delivery's webhook-signature.

post.summary: One of your applications was sent to the employer.
post.description: Posted once the send is confirmed, to each endpoint listening for it; data is the application as GET /applications/{id} returns it. A Discord or Slack incoming-webhook URL is sent a chat message naming the job instead (Discord {"content"}, Slack {"text"}), with the same headers. The headers follow Standard Webhooks: webhook-id names the event and is the same on every attempt, webhook-timestamp is the attempt's Unix time in seconds, and webhook-signature is "v1," then the base64 HMAC-SHA256 of "{webhook-id}.{webhook-timestamp}.{body}", keyed with the base64-decoded part of your secret after "whsec_". Answer with any 2xx within 10 seconds. Anything else, a redirect included, is tried again, 6 attempts in all over about ten hours, and refunded if none succeeds. Charged per delivery: $0.0010, free with Premium.

x-applystead-pricing.description: Each job a search or lookup returns: title, company, place, pay and pay estimate, posting link and dates.
Added per job when you ask for its details (include=details): skills, seniority, years of experience, visa sponsorship, clearance and travel.
Each company lookup that finds one: industry, size, headquarters, listing, filings and published wages.
Each job you add to your queue through the API. Refunded automatically if it is never sent.
Each event delivered to one of your webhook endpoints. Free with Premium; refunded automatically if it is never delivered.
